title: My party will protect self-respect of ‘original Reddys’, says Vijaya Sai Reddy
description: Both TDP and YSRCP have no love for Rayalaseema and are doing politics for votes and power, alleges the former Rajya Sabha member; among others, he promises free, quality education in government schools, 30 lakh jobs in five years, job calendar on January 1 every year, and  ₹10,000 monthly allowance to unemployed youth till they get job
